name: Juliet Nance
source:
The heroine of the story. She is in her first year of teaching at Saint-Agnes, a trial period for her.
Despite a relatively difficult class, she is doing very well and her future as a teacher looks very promising. But that was before a major event changed her destiny for the worse ...
